findings.description: William Hubert Ferber's father was Gerhard Ferber, a German immigrant. Gerhard was born about 1820 in Germany, immigrated to the United States around 1849-1850, was naturalized in Ohio in 1853, and settled in Cincinnati, Hamilton County, Ohio. Recovering him establishes the paternal side of William's ancestral origins. The 1870 census lists infant William in Gerhard's household, and William's own 1903 Ohio death record separately names Gerhard as his father.
supporting_sources: United States, Census, 1870, Cincinnati Ward 7, Hamilton County, Ohio, listing Gerhardt and Eva Faerber with infant William.
Ohio, County Death Records, 1840-2001, entry for Wm. Ferber, died 11 Mar 1903 — separately names Gerhard Ferber as the decedent's father.

findings.description: William Hubert Ferber's mother was Eva Engermann, wife of Gerhard Ferber. Eva was born about 1834 in Bavaria (German Empire) and died 1 January 1872 in Cincinnati, Ohio. Recovering her establishes the maternal side of William's ancestral origins in the German-speaking lands.
supporting_sources: United States, Census, 1870, Cincinnati Ward 7, Hamilton County, Ohio, listing Gerhardt and Eva Faerber with infant William.
United States, Census, 1900, giving William Ferber's parents' birthplace as Germany (origin breadcrumb; does not name the mother).

findings.description: William Hubert Ferber died 11 March 1903 in Cincinnati, Hamilton County, Ohio. This is the central death detail; the indexed Ohio death record gives the exact date and place.
supporting_sources: Ohio, County Death Records, 1840-2001, entry for Wm. Ferber, died 11 Mar 1903, Cincinnati, Hamilton County, Ohio.
Find a Grave Index, memorial for William H Ferber.

findings.description: William Hubert Ferber was buried in Cincinnati, Hamilton County, Ohio — at Spring Grove Cemetery, per the cemetery index and Find a Grave (the same cemetery where his mother Eva and wife Emma are buried). Recovering burial at Cincinnati is sufficient; the specific cemetery (Spring Grove) is a bonus detail.
supporting_sources: Cincinnati, Ohio, Spring Grove Cemetery Index, 1845-2012.
Find a Grave Index, memorial for William H Ferber.
